items.title: George "Pops" Foster Interview, 1958-08-24
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You know, Vestas told us how they'd dress up in the, Vestas told us and all that.

ctx.x: That was, that was around, I don't know, 1900, some way back then. Yeah, it would be way back then. See, John, see John, John, John was, wasn't no young man. John was, and he was a fine looking man.
You know, Vestas told us how they'd dress up in the, Vestas told us and all that.

Yeah, you know, it was very neat. Very neat. You see, you take, all the crew, because he used to always bore me out. We lived uptown, but I'd get up, and soon I'd get up right downtown. He used to bore me out, but moved downtown. My mother was working uptown, see, and we lived uptown, see. But I always, like, do many, that's why I know so much, see, now you, I know so much. See, now you ask me about places uptown, I didn't know.
